title: ¿Cómo se llega? — asking the way
summary: A stranger asks for the station. Directions, distances and the one question worth learning by heart: can you say it more slowly?

lines.speaker: A
lines.translation: Excuse me, is there a station near here?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sí, la estación de autobuses está a diez minutos andando.
lines.translation: Yes, the bus station is ten minutes' walk away.

lines.speaker: A
lines.translation: Can you say that again more slowly, please?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Claro. Siga todo recto por esta calle.
lines.translation: Of course. Go straight on along this street.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Después gire a la derecha en la plaza.
lines.translation: Then turn right at the square.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: La estación está enfrente de la iglesia.
lines.translation: The station is opposite the church.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, no está lejos. Un kilómetro, más o menos.
lines.translation: No, it is not far. A kilometre, more or less.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: ¿Y sabe a qué hora sale el próximo autobús?
lines.translation: And do you know what time the next bus leaves?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Creo que a las cuatro y media. Pero pregunte allí.
lines.translation: I think at half past four. But ask there.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Muchas gracias. Es usted muy amable.
lines.translation: Thank you very much. You are very kind.

vocabulary.meaning: more slowly — learn this one first

questions.q: What is the traveller looking for?
Which way does he turn at the square?

questions.explain: Un kilómetro, más o menos — and about ten minutes' walk, which agrees.

questions.q: What time does she think the next bus goes?
How sure is she about the time?
options: Not certain — she says to ask there
She does not know at all
questions.explain: Creo que… Pero pregunte allí. 'Creo que' is the signal that she is not sure.
